title: We each have our own mall world?
content: So like, you know the long standing theory of dreams are just generated runoff from your day/ life, anxieties presenting themselves, blah blah blah Well I started thinking when I saw that dream map crossposted a bit ago, that included the long road leading to the secret play beach.. So I have been to that beach many many times.. but that road for me is a road back from my hometown in TX called Knickerbocker road and I recognize it and follow it all the way to the secret play beach every time. So say, the person who had this drawing either imagines it as a random road with no connection to their childhood, or they start following one of their hometown roads too… like we all have the same/ similar layout of the dreamscape but our “subconscious” or whatever personalized it for us. I mean it just leads to many more questions like why are we programmed to dream of these specific places? And we could say it’s because we spent a lot of time at school, the mall, etc but I have hella waterpark dreams and have only been to a waterpark once.
